description.zh: 显示本机 IP 与国内外出口，可选增强网络信息
description.en: Show local and domestic/international egress IPs, with optional network details

desc.zh: 刷新出口检测结果，仍遵守各检测站的最小请求间隔
desc.en: Refresh egress results, still respecting per-detector rate limits

desc.zh: 仅查询本机网卡地址，不联网检测出口
desc.en: Query local adapter addresses only, no egress requests

tools.name: get_ip
tools.description: 获取本机物理网卡地址与国内站/国际站观察到的出口 IPv4。可选包含本机非临时/临时 IPv6 与IPv6 出口；增强网络信息开启时额外返回网关、隧道/虚拟网卡与代理状态。

include_ipv6.description: 是否包含有效本机非临时/临时 IPv6，并独立查询一组 IPv6 出口（仅本机模式不联网）

refresh.description: 刷新出口结果，仍遵守服务的最小请求间隔

tools.hint: 返回地址数组，每项含 ip/type、网卡或检测来源；首项 warnings 说明部分失败和代理状态

description.zh: IPv4 国内、国际检测分别降级；IPv6 开启后单独检测一组出口。选择仅本机地址时所有出口检测均不联网
description.en: Separate domestic/international IPv4 fallback chains; IPv6 uses one independent check when enabled. Local-only disables all egress requests

label.zh: 国内与国际 IPv4 出口
仅国内站 IPv4 出口
仅国际站 IPv4 出口

description.zh: 显示各一个有效非临时和临时 IPv6，并检测 IPv6 出口；IPv4 优先，更多地址见增强信息
description.en: Show one valid non-temporary and one temporary IPv6, and check IPv6 egress; IPv4 comes first, with more addresses in enhanced details

description.zh: 开启后额外查询并显示网关、隧道/虚拟网卡及系统代理状态
description.en: Also collect and show gateways, tunnel/virtual adapters and system proxy status when enabled

title.zh: 显示来源提供的归属地

description.zh: 检测来源提供时显示归属地，不额外发起定位请求
description.en: Display location supplied by the detector without extra geolocation requests

title.zh: 允许降级到备用检测站

description.zh: 各组主来源失败后按顺序尝试备用站；刷新会遵守站点请求间隔
description.en: Try backups within the same group after failure; refresh respects service rate limits

description.zh: 拖动排序，第一项为主来源；成功后停止，不会换成国际来源
description.en: Drag to reorder; first is primary, stop after success, never substitute an international source

description.zh: 默认优先 ifconfig.co，提供归属地；失败后使用 ipify（仅 IP）。ifconfig.co 每次请求至少间隔一分钟
description.en: Prefer ifconfig.co for location data; fall back to ipify (IP only). ifconfig.co requires at least one minute between requests

description.zh: 默认优先 test-ipv6.com，失败后使用 ipify；test-ipv6.com 每次请求至少间隔一分钟
description.en: Prefer test-ipv6.com, with ipify as backup; test-ipv6.com requests are at least one minute apart
